name: TestMnistOnnx
summary: This EA is a demonstration utility that uses an ONNX neural network model (MNIST) to classify hand-drawn digits on a canvas. The user draws a digit (0-9) on a 28x28 grid rendered via CCanvas, and the EA runs inference using OnnxRun to predict the digit. It has no trading functionality whatsoever — it is purely a machine learning inference demo.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个演示工具，使用ONNX神经网络模型（MNIST）对画布上手绘的数字进行分类识别。用户在通过CCanvas渲染的28x28网格上绘制数字（0-9），EA通过OnnxRun运行推理来预测该数字。它完全没有任何交易功能，纯粹是一个机器学习推理演示。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不包含任何交易策略，它是一个基于ONNX模型的MNIST手写数字识别演示工具。策略概念是利用预训练的卷积神经网络模型对用户在画布上绘制的数字进行分类推理。入场条件为用户点击CLASSIFY按钮触发推理，出场条件不适用，因为没有交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理均不涉及。整个流程是：用户在画布上用鼠标绘制数字 → 像素数据被采集并做平均池化降采样到28x28 → 归一化到0-1范围 → 送入ONNX模型推理 → softmax激活后取argmax得到预测数字。模型置信度低于0.8时会打印完整概率分布供调试参考。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA contains no trading strategy whatsoever; it is an MNIST handwritten digit recognition demo tool based on an ONNX model. The strategy concept is to use a pre-trained convolutional neural network model to classify digits drawn by the user on a canvas. The entry condition is the user clicking the CLASSIFY button to trigger inference, and exit conditions are not applicable since there are no trading operations. Position sizing and money management are completely absent — this EA does not open, manage, or close any trades. The full pipeline is: the user draws a digit on the canvas with the mouse → pixel data is collected and average-pooled down to 28x28 → normalized to the 0-1 range → fed into the ONNX model for inference → softmax activation is applied and argmax yields the predicted digit. When model confidence falls below 0.8, the full probability distribution is printed for debugging reference.

pros: 成功演示了MQL5中ONNX模型推理的完整流程，为机器学习在MetaTrader中的应用提供了参考范例
交互式画布设计直观，用户可以通过鼠标绘制并实时获取分类结果，用户体验良好
代码结构清晰，PrepareMatrix函数将像素采集、降采样和归一化分离，逻辑层次分明
pros_en: Successfully demonstrates the complete ONNX model inference pipeline in MQL5, providing a reference example for applying machine learning in MetaTrader
The interactive canvas design is intuitive — users can draw with the mouse and get real-time classification results, offering a good user experience
Clear code structure with the PrepareMatrix function cleanly separating pixel collection, downsampling, and normalization into distinct logical steps
cons: 无任何交易功能，作为EA发布意义有限，更适合作为示例脚本或指标
绘图精度受限于GRID_STEP的整数除法，可能导致边界像素丢失或降采样不够精确
缺少输入验证和异常处理，如ONNX模型加载失败后仍允许用户点击分类按钮，可能导致误导性结果
cons_en: No trading functionality at all — as a published EA its practical value is limited; it would be more appropriate as a sample script or indicator
Drawing precision is limited by integer division in GRID_STEP, which may cause edge pixel loss or inaccurate downsampling
Lacks input validation and error handling — for example, after ONNX model load failure the user can still click the classify button, potentially leading to misleading results
improvements: 增加对ONNX模型加载失败的UI状态管理，在模型不可用时禁用分类按钮并显示错误提示
优化降采样算法，使用双线性插值代替简单平均池化，提高手写数字识别准确率
增加模型置信度阈值参数化和低置信度结果的UI可视化提示，而非仅打印到日志
improvements_en: Add UI state management for ONNX model load failure — disable the classify button and display an error message when the model is unavailable
Optimize the downsampling algorithm by using bilinear interpolation instead of simple average pooling to improve handwritten digit recognition accuracy
Add parameterized confidence threshold and visual UI indication for low-confidence results instead of only printing to the log

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
ONNX模型推理失败时仅打印错误日志，PredictNumber返回-1但UI仍会显示-1作为预测结果，可能误导用户
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations — there is no financial risk
When ONNX inference fails, only an error log is printed; PredictNumber returns -1 but the UI still displays -1 as the prediction, which could mislead users

The user draws a digit (0-9) on a 28x28 grid rendered via CCanvas, and the EA runs inference using OnnxRun to predict the digit. It has no trading functionality whatsoever — it is purely a machine learning inference demo.
